title: District Commission must settle consumer dispute
description: The District Commission must settle the consumer dispute on the basis of evidence

conditions: opposite party denies or disputes allegations
opposite party omits or fails to take action to represent their case
limitations: complaint relates to goods in respect of which the procedure specified in sub-section (2) of section 36 cannot be followed
